data.narrative:
Cellares is a Series C-stage biotech company founded by Fabian Gerlinghaus and Omar Kurdi that has raised $350M+ to date. The valuation exercise draws on a comp universe of 3 public peers (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private peers in the Biotech & Health sector, with particular weight on 3 same-stage private comparables: Colossal Biosciences ($10.3B), Chai Discovery ($3.8B), and New Limit ($3.1B).

Two methods were triangulated. The Stage-Progression method applies a 1.7x step-up multiplier typical of Series C advancement, anchored to the $12M total-raised proxy, implying $20M. The Peer-Median method uses the median valuation of the 3 same-sector, same-stage comparables at $3.8B, with a range from $3.1B to $10.3B. Public-Comp Anchoring could not be applied due to absence of disclosed revenue data. These two applicable methods produce a triangulated range of $17M (low) to $4.4B (high), with a median of $1.9B. The wide spread reflects material dispersion within the peer set, particularly Colossal's $10.3B outlier valuation. Key uncertainties include the comparability of peer business models, revenue traction relative to peers, and the extent to which the $350M raised represents capital efficiency or capital intensity in this segment.
